what: An arch (halo shape) hanging below a section is tied to scroll and grows from .3x to full size as it moves to the next section — while the element’s bottom edge rises to 35% height from the screen bottom. The flipped container at the top of the next section uses start: top bottom.; end: top 35%; It scales up at the same ratio from origin: 50% 0 · with a from greater than 1 it starts enlarged and settles down to its own size (Footer version — darkens together via fade)

options.fade: Initial opacity — when given, it goes to 1 together with scale (if absent, opacity stays as is)
options.trigger: if parent, start and end are measured from the parent section’s position — for growing only the footer inner plate inside a gray plate. Otherwise the text is a css selector found in the document and measured from that element (wedding: the preceding video section .tr-video)

from.where: shared.js footer inner panel .ih-foot__inner — from: 1.175; fade: 0; start: top 90%; end: top 25%; origin: 50% 0; scrub: .5; trigger: parent (starts enlarged and transparent, then settles down and shrinks)

shared.js .js-parallax > .wf-img (contact band background · about · recruit opening photo) — original behavior.js js-parallax: img scale 1.2→1, from when the cell enters at the bottom of the screen until it leaves at the top, scrub 1
from.options: from: 1.2; start: top bottom; end: bottom top; origin: 50% 50%; scrub: 1; trigger: parent

from.where: index.html .tr-ceremony (white panel covering the full-bleed video) — from: .5; origin: 50% 50%; trigger: .tr-video; start: 30% bottom; end: 40% top-=20% (scrub attaches immediately by default, curve none)
